// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func init() {
	debug.SetGCPercent(10)
}

func scenario585Positive(items []string) []string {
	processed := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		intermediate := make([]byte, 0, len(item))
		intermediate = append(intermediate, []byte(item)...)
		processed = append(processed, string(intermediate)+"_done")
	}
	return processed
}
